Bluesheet for interim-2026-sshm-01
========================================================================

13 attendees.


Stephen Farrell	
Marc Penninga	
Scott Fluhrer	
Lucas Prabel	
Damien Miller	
Casey Wynn	
Job Snijders	
Deb Cooley	
Alicja Kario	
Ben S	
Guilin WANG	
Dmitry Belyavskiy	
John Preuß Mattsson

chat.author: Alicja Kario
chat.text: good morning!

chat.author: Lucas Prabel
chat.text: I can help with the notes!

chat.author: Scott Fluhrer
chat.text: I agree that we should limit the number of combinations - two is good

chat.author: Alicja Kario
chat.text: :-1: to combinatorial explosion

chat.author: Alicja Kario
chat.text: yes, :+1: to ML-DSA-87+P384

chat.author: Scott Fluhrer
chat.text: Who's aligning to ML-DSA-44?  From what I see, that size doesn't appear to have a lot to take up

chat.author: Alicja Kario
chat.text: the point is not to create a standard with 20 choices, 2 or 3 are fine

chat.author: Alicja Kario
chat.text: I think there's too few of us here

chat.author: Alicja Kario
chat.text:
"no" to seed for ECDSA/EdDSA
"yes" to seed for ML-DSA

chat.author: Damien Miller
chat.text:
draft is currently seed for ML-DSA and Ed25519, but expanded key for ECDSA
libcrypto supports Ed25519 seeds ok

chat.author: Damien Miller
chat.text: the composite is only strongly unforgeable against a classical adversary, no?

chat.author: Lucas Prabel
chat.text: Yes, with EdDSA component, only SUF secure against classical adversary

chat.author: Damien Miller
chat.text: sorry, yes - I should have qualified that better

chat.author: John Preuß Mattsson
chat.text:
RFC 8709 points normatively to RFC 8032. My understanding is that RFC 8032 provides SUF-CMA. A SSH implementation not being conformant to RFC 8032 is not conformant to RFC 8709
https://www.ietf.org/ietf-ftp/rfc/rfc8709.html

chat.author: Deb Cooley
chat.text: did Damien have other questions?

chat.author: Deb Cooley
chat.text: (on the comp sig drafts)

chat.author: Damien Miller
chat.text:
sorry, my chronology was wrong
but yeah, many SSH implementations use djb's reference implementation that does not include the checks needed for SUF-CMA

chat.author: Dmitry Belyavskiy
chat.text: I'm fine with it, but wouldn't want any hybrids

chat.author: Dmitry Belyavskiy
chat.text: (SLHDSA)

chat.author: Deb Cooley
chat.text: Can the number of options be cut down?

chat.author: Damien Miller
chat.text: Does Simon have a SLH-DSA draft ready to go as soon as we have bandwidth?

chat.author: Deb Cooley
chat.text: he does

chat.author: Damien Miller
chat.text: Yes please, keep the SF meeting. I'll be there

chat.author: Job Snijders
chat.text: Yes, I’ll be there in person

chat.author: Damien Miller
chat.text: I have local guides to cocktail bars

chat.author: Job Snijders
chat.text: Audio is a bit fumbled, we are talking GSS API?

chat.author: Stephen Farrell
chat.text: yep

chat.author: Deb Cooley
chat.text: This is a 90 min session....

chat.author: Damien Miller
chat.text: FWIW I understood the decision to no do ML-DSA now to be more about ordering and bandwidth than a "no not ever" decision

chat.author: Deb Cooley
chat.text: you have 30 min left

chat.author: Deb Cooley
chat.text: ooof

chat.author: Deb Cooley
chat.text: is there a draft for gss-api?

chat.author: Job Snijders
chat.text: AFAIK yes

chat.author: Stephen Farrell
chat.text: yep iirc

chat.author: Alicja Kario
chat.text: yes, there is

chat.author: Alicja Kario
chat.text: https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-kario-gss-keyex-pqc/

chat.author: Deb Cooley
chat.text: I added the gss-api draft to the ssh related drafts.

chat.author: Job Snijders
chat.text: I have a topic as wg participant

chat.author: Dmitry Belyavskiy
chat.text: Deb, many thanks!

chat.author: Alicja Kario
chat.text: Thank you Deb!

chat.author: Damien Miller
chat.text: thanks all; I hope you get some sleep Deb (or enjoy the early start?)

chat.author: Damien Miller
chat.text:
IMO we have two choices:
1) do the work to make compression per channel (and perhaps in doing so adopt some new algorithms like zstd)
2) deprecate (dis-recommend) the current compression scheme in SSH
these are not mutually exclusive

chat.author: Stephen Farrell
chat.text: is there any in-play draft that could sensibly do (2) above?

chat.author: Damien Miller
chat.text: not that I'm aware of

chat.author: Damien Miller
chat.text: +1 to deprecating transport level compression

chat.author: John Preuß Mattsson
chat.text: yes please

chat.author: Damien Miller
chat.text: I've written my share of drafts for now

chat.author: Damien Miller
chat.text: thanks again all

chat.author: Lucas Prabel
chat.text: Thanks!

chat.author: Alicja Kario
chat.text: bye!

chat.author: Dmitry Belyavskiy
chat.text: Thanks, see you!
